techs.name: Overclocked Short-Circuit
techs.notes: LINE_PIERCE 10.0 that stops at the first non-metal. Arcs through metal without touching what is behind it. Magnetized targets: +1 shave.

techs.name: Solar Railgun
techs.notes: 3 rail hits + 1 burn tick (15% of raw). Cassia's induction barrel fires Crono as a human comet. A Break leaves a Venn residual (watercolour + amber pool). +20% if Crono is cracked and Cassia consenting.

techs.name: Reinforced Guard
techs.notes: Ch3, after the Mercy branch (read as the Arris Dome put to sleep). Reinforced: Crono's Time Debt accrual -50% for the next 3 gate jumps. The first Venn Double.

techs.name: Iron Maiden Scroll
techs.notes: 1.8 total over 5 hits. A sumi-e scroll unfurls and clay legs hammer the iron maiden shut; Krona shreds it. Ash and amber DoTs inside are doubled. +25% if it closes on a Vaelos minion.

techs.name: Time Mines
techs.notes: Available whenever Sera fights beside Cassia-09 (from Ch3). 3 mines at enemies' last-turn-start positions, 2 hits per mine; mine radius 1.0 chosen. An enemy that returns to its spot, or is Rewound to it, detonates the mine.

techs.name: Solar Winds
techs.notes: 3 gusts, 1.5 total. Moebius wind lines carry watercolour light along the tether vines. +35% with Sunlight Stacks. Wakes seed bridges.

techs.name: Triangulation
techs.notes: Along a tether. Crono dashes along Xyloph's tether: a guaranteed crit and +1.2 s Break. Stabilizes his galaxy core at 20% (the endgame core-lattice key).

techs.name: Spore Rail
techs.notes: 2 rail hits of 1.4 + 4 spore hits of 0.3 (4.0 total spread over 6 hits). AoE 1.0 -> 2.0 sprout. Needs an active tether: severed tethers become shrapnel (+2 shave) and their stored shared damage releases as an AoE heal; a walkable vine rail grows along the line. +20% if tethered.

techs.name: Mycelia Time Lapse
techs.notes: Sera's 5% sol is refunded. Spore ticks 300% faster; shaves nothing; Break +1.5 s. The three-phase-boss tool.

techs.name: Vitreous Refraction
techs.notes: 7 beams, one per universe shader (AoE 1.7 rainbow floor); the cat pounces each beam. +25% if the light passes through a tether. Every hit carries both [VITREOUS] and [TACHYON] (the Goyama Daimyo's seal).

techs.name: Refraction Needle
techs.notes: LINE 15.0 split into 3 lines. Up to 12 shave on a target weak to [TACHYON][VITREOUS]. Triple bell.

techs.name: Chrono Prism
techs.notes: With Schala's cat. Placed by hand during a 4 s time stop of real time. +4 shave. Requires Crono <= 60%. Three elements: matches [PRISMATIC]. The Luminaire + Vitreous fusion.

techs.name: Prismlight Salvo
techs.notes: A refracted rail the cat aims; Ferro Graviton shards doubled. On a target weak to [VITREOUS][FERRO] it reveals the U4 secret chest.

techs.name: Ash Graveyard
techs.notes: Ruin and light paradox: Ash ground becomes a stained-glass caustic floor that heals allies 3% per 2 s. Strong vs the Arch-Curators.

techs.name: Bloom Crown
techs.notes: SELF_AURA 3.0 around both. Grows a Saurian canopy: +1 Sunlight Stack every 5 s for 15 s; light through it heals 2% per tick.

techs.name: Masque Feint
techs.notes: 1 steal + 1 reflect (1.2 + mirror). Steals one buff; the stained-glass undermask stores the target's next attack and reflects it. +40% vs bosses (the stolen face cracks).

techs.name: Guilt Halo
techs.notes: SELF_AURA 3.5 around Crono. Steals 1 BP on a Break; Crono's ceiling costs halve for 1 turn (the doll holds).

techs.name: Honest Stage
techs.notes: Cuts threads and catches a puppet balloon. +4 shave. Requires Crono <= 60%, his crack visible. Overlapping a CIRCLE and a SELF_AURA it becomes a Venn Double: the copy's admission.

techs.name: Ashen Bash
techs.notes: Ch6 (teased Ch1). One sword stroke, two hose-arm prop blows. Locked if the Atrium dummy was Salvaged (Glenn_Duals_Refused).

techs.name: Mercy Leap
techs.notes: Ch6 (teased Ch1). 2 hits (3 with Glenn_Arm_HoseArm_Accepted: the origami frog as a projectile). Glenn's hose arm flings Sera along the line; she lands behind the last target. With Vesper in Sera's place the leap refracts into a seven-colour [VITREOUS] prism burst that heals the party 15% and clears Grief-Resonance; +50% healing once the Schala-cat is fully inside the glass. Locked if the dummy was Salvaged.

techs.name: Ruin Elastic
techs.notes: Reach 6.0; 1 hit + decoy. Sumi-e ink stretched 300%; the elastic decoy draws the target's next action.

techs.name: Omega Annihilation
techs.notes: 2 collapse hits, 2.4 total. Tachyon flicker plus white-noise cancellation: silences and rewinds a boss ultimate (cancels its wind-up and sets its gauge to 0). +50% vs Vaelos (brother frequency). A second use in one battle costs Sera another 10%.

techs.name: Tachyon Static
techs.notes: Scrambles the next phase's reveal (the boss's next weaknesses start hidden; the first Break of that phase gets +1 shave per hit). Both actors phase: +50% evasion until their next turn.

techs.name: Anachronism Glass
techs.notes: 1988 smear frames become solid glass: allies inside gain a Glass Ward (the next 2 hits they take are halved).

techs.name: Graviton Whiteout
techs.notes: Magnetic static: no shield regeneration or rebuild for 5 s.

techs.name: Solar Railgun + HZ
techs.notes: Watercolour smear under cel lines, an intentional style bleed showing Crono's crack. +1 shave per hit if Static is tuned CARRION on the target.

techs.name: Ferro Null
techs.notes: Ch3 (Dark >= 40), Crono's void echo. 2 hits (ferro, then null). Shaves 8 on any target and adds +8 Dark. Breaking R-66Y with it in the Phase 2 branch writes R66Y_Salvaged; his mask weeps black oil from then on.

techs.name: Empress Cannon
techs.notes: Cassia-09 Bipedal form. The Lavos-Grafted Laser Cannon from R-66Y. Each use +2 Dark (cap +10 per universe).

techs.name: Origami Requiem
techs.notes: Crono + Sera carrying Kami-Ori's crane; Crono + Omega-Spekkio once he joins (3% + 8 MP). A watercolour dash along a fold line folds the enemy's past away and leaves a gold field that thaws Ruin 1% per 8 s. Boost Lv3 +1 shave.

techs.name: Time Debt Paid
techs.notes: Heals 40%, removes all Glaze Erosion, and with Light grants an auto-revive this battle. A kintsugi mini-game after the battle returns the 10 integrity if completed.

techs.name: Porcelain Promise Child
techs.notes: Ending 3 (Ch12). The child holds the doll's cracked hand while Crono holds his: heals allies inside, clears 5% of Crono's Battle Strain and restores +1 integrity once per battle.
